name: Fangfosh
look: a little pale aqua fish on blue frog legs with a huge grimace of square white teeth, big round blue eyes, a black stripe into a black dorsal fin and a blue tail fin
entry: It is always grinning like that, even when it is scared, which makes it very hard to tell what it is feeling. It hops out of the water on its little legs to bite at ankles.
how: One of the A. Fakemon starters: pick it at the starter screen (its own A. Fakemon page).
Wild: very rare by rivers and in swamps.
